title: AI-nimator ControlPreset
description: One named control-signal configuration consumed by the engine plugins (Unity ScriptableObject / Unreal UDataAsset are hydrated from these). Values are RAW (unnormalized): vx/vz in meters per frame in the root-local ground frame; the engine applies the z-norm from norm_stats.json. aim is unit-norm by construction.

name.description: Preset identifier (snake_case, doubles as the filename stem).

vx.description: Desired lateral velocity, meters/frame, root-local frame.

vz.description: Desired forward velocity, meters/frame, root-local frame (+Z = facing).

aim_x.description: Aim direction X component (unit-norm 2D vector with aim_z).

aim_z.description: Aim direction Z component (unit-norm 2D vector with aim_x).

prompt.description: Optional authoring-time text prompt this preset was built for (informational; the runtime consumes prompt_emb, not text).

prompt_emb.description: Optional precomputed prompt embedding (length must equal manifest.prompt_emb_channels). B0 packaging decision: prompts ship as precomputed embeddings, not as an in-engine text encoder — see inference_contract.md.
